# About This Site

::::: {style="border: 2px solid #66ada9; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;"}
::: {style="font-size: 1.3rem; color: #6c757d;"}
This portfolio was designed and hand-coded by me using <br> **Quarto**, **HTML**, **CSS/SCSS**, and **R**. No drag-and-drop builders involved!
:::

#### See how it all came together: <br> <https://github.com/kathleen-juarez/portfolio-site.git>

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" style="border-left-color: #66ada9;"}
## What's GitHub?

GitHub is a website where people store and share code. Think of it like Google Drive, but specifically designed for software projects. It lets developers save their work, track changes over time, and collaborate with others without overwriting each other's work.

*If you're asking yourself this question, you've clearly never spent the night crying in front of your computer after unsuccessfully trying to push your code to GitHub, merge divergent branches, and then lose your entire document in the process. Ah, to have a layman's innocence.*
:::
:::::

### What went into it

-   **Design** — layout, color palette, and typography decisions made from scratch
-   **Structure** — built with Quarto's publishing framework, configured for GitHub Pages hosting
-   **Styling** — custom CSS/SCSS architecture: global styles, hero-specific styles, and per-page stylesheets
-   **Debugging** — a *lot* of it (see below)

### Tools Used

| Tool          | Purpose                               |
|---------------|---------------------------------------|
| Quarto        | Site framework & rendering            |
| CSS / SCSS    | Custom styling & Bootswatch overrides |
| HTML          | Custom components & page structure    |
| R             | Dashboard templating & rendering      |
| GitHub        | Version control & hosting             |
| Chart.js      | Interactive data visualizations       |
| Flexdashboard | Analytics dashboard layout            |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

#### 🚀 Setup & Deployment

```{=html}
<div class="changelog-section">
<table class="changelog-table">
  <thead><tr><th>When</th><th>What happened</th><th>Details</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td><span class="badge-date">~Apr 2026</span></td><td>Initial GitHub Pages deployment</td><td>Set up Quarto project. Configured <code>output-dir: docs</code> in <code>_quarto.yml</code> so rendered files go to <code>/docs</code>.</td></tr>
    <tr><td><span class="badge-date">~Apr 2026</span></td><td>Fixed 404 on live site</td><td>GitHub Pages was running Jekyll on Quarto output, ignoring folders starting with underscores. Fixed by creating <code>.nojekyll</code> in <code>/docs</code>.</td></tr>
    <tr><td><span class="badge-date">~Apr 2026</span></td><td>Installed Quarto R package</td><td>Resolved <em>'no package called quarto'</em> error. Switched to <code>quarto render</code> in RStudio Terminal going forward.</td></tr>
    <tr><td><span class="badge-date">~Apr 2026</span></td><td>Fixed duplicate YAML key error</td><td>Resolved <code>YAMLException: duplicated mapping key</code> — caused by <code>website:</code> appearing twice in <code>_quarto.yml</code>.</td></tr>
    <tr><td><span class="badge-date">~Apr 2026</span></td><td>Fixed broken CSS/assets on live site</td><td>Site appeared unstyled post-publish. Fixed by adding <code>site-url: 'https://kathleenjuarez.com'</code> to <code>_quarto.yml</code>.</td></tr>
    <tr><td><span class="badge-date">~Apr 2026</span></td><td>Connected custom domain</td><td>Added 4 A records and a CNAME for www pointing to <code>kathleen-juarez.github.io</code>. DNS propagation took ~4 hours.</td></tr>
    <tr><td><span class="badge-date">~Apr 2026</span></td><td>Renamed styles.css → styles.scss</td><td>Quarto threw an unexpected <code>'$'</code> error because the CSS file contained Sass variable syntax. Renamed, moved to <code>theme:</code> list, added <code>/*-- scss:rules --*/</code> divider.</td></tr>
    <tr><td><span class="badge-date">May 2026</span></td><td>Git branch divergence fix</td><td>Resolved non-fast-forward push errors. Workflow: <code>git stash → git restore → git pull --rebase</code>. Root cause: RStudio auto-regenerating a file after stashing.</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
</div>
```
